purpose: Determine whether CAP01 failure is root-specific or a broader transient sink/window-scale limitation before considering any repair.

paired_routes.drainage_sink: same frozen sink distribution in one drainage level

interpretation_rules: If ROOT and GENERIC have the same accept/reject pattern across all durations, do not classify the failure as root-specific.
If GENERIC succeeds at a duration where ROOT fails, classify a root-specific execution discrepancy and trace provider/binding/HeadCalc semantics.
If both routes fail only at short durations but succeed at longer durations, classify CAP01 primarily as a coupling-window numerical-envelope problem.
If both routes fail at all durations through solver rejection, investigate common transient sink/Newton execution before any root-specific repair.
If both routes succeed at the same duration, compare accepted storage/head response and mass accounting; material divergence is a semantic discrepancy.
No duration, sink magnitude, solver tolerance or retry limit may be changed after observing this D1 sweep.
